name: Muzero Acquisition Corp Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Muzero Acquisition Corp. functions as a blank check company, established with the singular objective of pursuing and completing a business combination. Its strategic aims encompass various forms of transactions, such as a merger, amalgamation, equity swap, asset acquisition, share purchase, corporate restructuring, or any similar unification with one or more other enterprises. This entity was founded on October 10, 2025, and its principal offices are located in New York, New York.
